coordinateAttribution: Coordinates and locality records: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/.
referencePolicy: Use verified populated-place points; preserve existing Bali/Denpasar (-8.65, 115.22) and Tenerife/El Médano (28.041389, -16.541944) anchors. These coordinates identify places, not weather stations.
crowdSeasonPolicy: Peak and shoulder arrays inherit existing CITY_ROWS regional estimates verbatim. They are not measured local crowds.
timeZonePolicy: Numeric tz fields follow the app's existing fixed standard-offset model: Bali +8, Tenerife 0. Atlantic/Canary has seasonal daylight saving; fixed offsets are a travel heuristic, not a date-specific time-zone conversion.
climatePolicy: Each new point has an independently requested and validated 1991–2020 NASA POWER baseline. Identical actual daily series are explicitly identified; no neighbouring station observations are copied. Exact point labels do not increase the regional MERRA-2 source resolution.
